explanation: The correct answer is $324$. For a number to be $35\%$ greater than $240$, it follows that the number is $\left(100\% \text{ of } 240\right) + \left(35\% \text{ of } 240\right)$, which can be written as $\frac{100}{100}\left(240\right) + \frac{35}{100}\left(240\right)$. This expression is equivalent to $1\left(240\right) + 0.35\left(240\right)$, or $1.35\left(240\right)$, which is equal to $324$. Therefore, $324$ is $35\%$ greater than $240$.
